messages:
anya: Quick sync — dedicated autoscale policy options for the next OKR planning. Customers keep asking for stronger burst guarantees without blowing up cost. Need to pick a primary approach for Q3: 1) hard reserved burst pockets, 2) soft-preempt credits, or 3) dynamic burst with SLA tiers. Thoughts?

matt: I lean toward soft-preempt credits as default — predictable cost for customers and simpler to bill. But we’ll need clear eviction rules.

kevin: soft-preempt + observability sounds good. Biggest risk is noisy neighbors causing tail latency. How do we surface per-customer interference?

olivia: we can add an isolation score in console (per-route) and show projected tail latencies if they opt into cheaper tiers. That helps sales.

anya: agreed. Proposal: default = soft-preempt credits with optional reserved pockets for enterprise. Reserve pockets are an add-on SKU. Keeps PLG flow intact.

sarah: launch criteria idea: (a) end-to-end billing + usage UI, (b) eviction policy doc + test harness, (c) perf regressions <5% p99 on benchmark workloads. Do we need legal signoff for SLA language?

jeff: legal + compliance will need the failure modes spelled out. Also ops wants automatic rollback to lower model variant when capacity constrained. Add that to the playbook.

anya: note for scope negotiation: MVP soft-preempt should NOT include cross-region fallback. That can be Q4. Keep scope tight.

matt: customer-driven ask from AcmeCorp: guaranteed 90th percentile burst throughput for 5 mins. Can we model that in credits?

kevin: yes, credits can map to GPU-seconds. Need to translate their usage pattern into a credit curve. I can build a converter in 2 sprints.

olivia: Ops question — how do we surface when a customer burns through credits? Push alerts + quota UI + webhook.

anya: add to checklist: webhook + slack notification channel + console banner.

jeff: also add experiment: a beta with 5 customers to validate billing and eviction UX.

deploy-bot: note created: #ticket-4521 'soft-preempt credits MVP' assigned to kevin, eta: 2026-01-22.

anya: OKRs alignment: this maps to Product OKR 2 (reduce tail latency incidents) and Revenue KR for Dedicated add-on adoption. Decision: go soft-preempt credits MVP, reserved pockets enterprise add-on later. I'll write PRD and circulate for comments by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
